summary: Iter280: tested Bird-style sidebar, Home product grid, landing products section/mega menu/copy, caller-ID Bird-only backend + UI, and the Bird-only outbound unit test. Sidebar, Home grid, landing product cards, mega menu and pricing CTA all work and prices are correct. Found 3 real bugs: (1) GET /caller-ids still returns attested and method=review docs as status=verified, so the UI lists them as verified and offers them in the 'Softphone (SIP) calls show' selector; (2) the landing FAQ only renders the first 14 items, so the rewritten 'How does texting work?' and 'What does each plan include?' answers never show (same for SIP FAQ / Help, which use faqItems differently); (3) the visible FAQ 'How much does fax cost?' still says $15 a month (confirmed price and backend default are $9). There is also stale copy that contradicts Bird-only caller IDs.

critical.issue: The list filter (caller-ids.js L133) keeps every status=verified doc, including method=attested/attested:true and method=review (admin-approved legacy) docs, and returns them as status 'verified'. Presets exclude them correctly, but CallerIdManager (CallerIds.js L129 items = status==='verified') shows them as verified caller IDs with a check icon, and the SIP default <select> offers them. Picking one then fails because resolve() rejects it. Fix: add method/attested to view(), and filter or flag those docs (for example status 'needs_verification' with a Verify button), or exclude them from the list.

minor.issue: Async rejections from getTrialCaller and ce.createOutboundCall are now contained ({error,status:503} plus birdAlert). SYNCHRONOUS throws are not: `require('../ivr-outbound').getTrialCaller(...)` and `ce.createOutboundCall(...)` are called before `.catch`, so a non-async throw escapes. The real functions are async, so the risk is low. Hardening: wrap both in try or use `Promise.resolve().then(() => ...)`. New unit cases 15a/15b document this (2 FAIL).

The if(false) blocks are gone, but some code can no longer run: L113 rejects any showAs, which makes `showAs = null` and the showAs scam-watch alert at L126 unreachable. L140 also can never run because L139 already returns on any showAs, and L158 `_showAs(req.body.showAs)` is always undefined.

Admin approve now returns null, which is correct, but the admin list still shows review docs and the approve buttons and copy in admin.js (`notify`/`sendMail` approve texts) are dead. Consider removing the approve action from the admin UI.

ui_bugs.issue: faqItems(catalog).slice(0, 14) only renders the first 14 questions. 'How does texting work?' and 'What does each plan include?' are at index ~17-18 and never appear on /cloudivr, so the copy fixes requested for this round are invisible. Fix: move them into the first 14, remove the slice, or add a 'Show all' control.

ui_bugs.component: Landing FAQ 'How much does fax cost?' (PricingFaq.js L96, faq-question-4)
ui_bugs.issue: Says 'A fax number is $15 a month'. The confirmed price is $9/mo, which matches the hero card, the product card and js/fax-numbers.js PRICE default of 9.

ui_bugs.component: Caller IDs manager list + SIP default select
ui_bugs.issue: Attested caller IDs show as verified and can be picked (UI side of the GET /caller-ids backend bug).

issues: Bullet says 'Show your verified caller ID — no account, no card', but the backend rejects showAs on free test calls (trycall.js L113/L139). Remove or replace this bullet.

design_issues.screen: Numbers page 'Your own caller IDs' card intro
issues: Copy still reads '... or, on Business, save up to 10 numbers you have the right to use and pick one with a tap'. This is stale and implies no-code caller IDs. Reword it to say Bird code verification only.

design_issues.screen: Landing FAQ 'Can the Texting Number make calls?'
issues: Says the Texting Number is 'also a free verified caller ID'. Check this is still true under Bird-only (method 'auto' docs are allowed by presets, so it is probably fine). Flagged for consistency.
The 'What do you want to do?' guided-task grid uses only about 1090px of the 1260px content width, leaving an empty right column. Minor.
The Home 'USA eSIM' tile price shows a vague 'Monthly', while the landing card shows $75/mo. Pass esimPrice to the Home grid too.
The sidebar groups 'Fax & eSIM' together, but Home and landing put eSIM under 'Phones, data & tools'. Slight naming inconsistency, minor.
No <h1> on /cloudivr/app/travel-esim, unlike every other page. Minor accessibility issue.

passed_checks: Sidebar at 1920: groups in order home, numbers, calls, ai, messaging, more, tools, account (support last). Every item has a coloured civr-chip (slate, blue, amber, violet, green, teal). The sidebar background is white with link text rgb(51,65,85) and labels rgb(100,116,139). The active item is highlighted (#eef4ff). The sub-badges are IVR, IVR, SIP, Soon and Soon.

All 26 sidebar links navigate to the correct page with aria-current=page and no crash. Tools folds and unfolds. The active group stays open. Browser phone opens softphone-panel. section-tabs-numbers is present.

Home: stat-* row sits at the top, above home-products. All 5 groups and all 14 tiles have correct hrefs and prices. home-product-intl-texting-soon is present. dashboard-new-products is gone. Tiles navigate (fax, receptionist).

Landing #products: all 5 groups and 14 cards have correct prices (USA eSIM $75/mo from catalog). The plan CTA goes to #pricing. Other CTAs go to /cloudivr/signup when logged out. intl-texting shows Coming soon with no CTA.
Mega menu: nav-menu-group-calling, -mobile and -tools are present. fax, travel, lookup, mobile, tendlc and intl items link to the #product-* anchors.

Copy: no 'SMS inbox', no $0.05, hero chip reads 'Try a free call first', Landline to Texting is marked soon, the sms tab describes the USA Texting Number at $50/mo, the phone tab says 'From Starter up ... SIP'. pricing-choose-texting is not clipped at 1920.

Caller IDs backend: presets exclude attested, review and method=review-verified docs. POST /caller-ids/request returns 410 verification_required. POST /caller-ids/attest returns 400 with and without authorized. adminApi.approve returns null and the doc stays in review. resolve() rejects method=review and attested docs and accepts method=call.
Caller IDs UI: caller-ids-review-open and the method select are gone. caller-ids-method-note says Bird calls with a code.
Bot customCidEnter: typed numbers that are not presets get VERIFY_MSG pointing to app verification. The trial ctx explains that the CloudIVR number is shown.
Mobile 390: Home products and landing products have no horizontal overflow and the cards are readable.
action_items: Fix GET /api/cloudivr-web/caller-ids so attested and method=review docs are not returned as verified. They must not appear as verified in CallerIdManager or in the SIP default select.
Landing FAQ: make 'How does texting work?' and 'What does each plan include?' visible. They are cut off by .slice(0, 14).
Landing FAQ 'How much does fax cost?': change $15 a month to $9 a month.
Remove the 'Show your verified caller ID — no account, no card' bullet from TryCall.js POINTS.
Reword the 'Your own caller IDs' card intro to drop the 'on Business, save numbers you have the right to use' wording.

Optional: wrap getTrialCaller and ce.createOutboundCall calls in try to contain synchronous throws, then re-run bird_only_outbound_unit_test.js (now 22 cases: 20 pass, 2 sync-throw fail). Remove the unreachable showAs code in trycall.js.
critical_code_review_comments: caller-ids.js view() does not expose attested, and the list filter does not exclude non-code methods. The single source of truth for 'usable' should be presets(), and the list should mark everything else as not usable.
PricingFaq faqItems is also used by Help.js (slice(2)) and sip/Plans.js. The stale $15 fax copy spreads to the Help center as well.
signalwire/index.js Bird-only path: `.then(...).catch(...)` only contains async errors. Use try/await for both calls.

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/17 pytest; node unit 20/22 - 2 fails are sync-throw hardening cases)
success_rate.frontend: 88% (sidebar/home/landing products/menu pass; FAQ visibility, fax FAQ price, caller-ID list fail)

Caller-ID UI is only visible when appSettings.customCallerId.enabled=true. node backend/tests/bird_only_outbound_unit_test.js now has 22 cases.
